payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Create a vibrant gradient interface inspired by Northern Lights with mesh gradients, smooth color blends, flowing animations. Use complementary color pairs (blue-orange, purple-yellow), flowing background gradients, subtle continuous animations (8-12s loops), iridescent effects.
payload.best_for: Modern SaaS, creative agencies, branding, music platforms, lifestyle, premium products, hero sections
payload.css_technical_keywords: background: conic-gradient or radial-gradient with multiple stops, animation: @keyframes gradient (8-12s), background-size: 200% 200%, filter: saturate(1.2), blend-mode: screen or multiply
payload.do_not_use_for: Data-heavy dashboards, critical accessibility, content-heavy where distraction issues
payload.effects_and_animation: Large flowing CSS/SVG gradients, subtle 8-12s animations, depth via color layering, smooth morph
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Mesh/flowing gradients applied, ☐ 8-12s animation loop, ☐ Complementary colors used, ☐ Smooth color transitions, ☐ Iridescent effect subtle, ☐ Text contrast verified
payload.keywords: Vibrant gradients, smooth blend, Northern Lights effect, mesh gradient, luminous, atmospheric, abstract
payload.primary_colors: Complementary: Blue-Orange, Purple-Yellow, Electric Blue #0080FF, Magenta #FF1493, Cyan #00FFFF
payload.secondary_colors: Smooth transitions (Blue→Purple→Pink→Teal), iridescent effects, blend modes (screen, multiply)
